biography: Keijo Erik 'Keke' Rosberg, a Finn with ice in his veins and fire in his heart, burst onto the motorsport scene with a raw, untamed talent. Hailing from the small town of Iisalmi, Keke's passion for speed ignited early, fueled by the roar of rally cars echoing through the forests. He honed his skills in local karting circuits, quickly outgrowing the amateur ranks and setting his sights on the grand stage. His aggressive driving style and flamboyant persona caught the eye of McLean G.P., where he spent his formative years. A defining moment came at the Didcot Racing, where, despite a car disadvantage, he wrestled his machine to a podium finish, showcasing his exceptional car control and race craft. Now at 32, and driving for AMG Mercedes Berlin2000, Keke is at the peak of his powers, a seasoned veteran with the hunger of a rookie.
drivingStyle: Keke's driving style is a spectacle of controlled aggression. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and a willingness to push the limits of his car, often flirting with the edge of control. His tire management is adequate but not his strength; he favors an all-out attack, sacrificing longevity for raw speed. In high-pressure situations, Keke thrives, his flashy persona giving way to a steely focus that allows him to extract every last ounce of performance from his car. He truly embodies the 'attack is the best defense' philosophy.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about pushing the envelope until it screams!"
careerHighlight: Winning the Didcot Grand Prix in 2024. Starting from 8th on the grid, Keke masterfully navigated treacherous weather conditions and overtook several rivals in the closing laps to secure a memorable victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the McLean G.P. in 2021 while leading the race. A mechanical failure sent him spinning into the barriers, ending his hopes for a maiden victory and denting his confidence.
